item.title: Pakistan court order police to find abducted 13-year-old Christian girl forcibly married to Muslim man
item.description: A federal court in Pakistan has ordered police to find a 13-year-old girl who was forcibly converted and married to a Muslim man. #Pakistan #abudction #forcedconversion

item.title: 'American Idol' contestant reveals God's supernatural deliverance from crippling fear
item.description: Ashley Tankard always dreamed of performing on "American Idol," using her God-given voice to entertain and inspire. #AmericanIdol #AshleyTankard #testimony #fear

item.title: Vice President JD Vance to speak at 53rd annual March for Life
item.description: Vice President JD Vance is scheduled to deliver in-person remarks at the 53rd annual March for Life rally in Washington, D.C., the largest annual pro-life gathering in the United States. #MarchforLife #abortion #prolife #JDVance #Vance #Trump #NationalMall

item.title: Missing Christian girl forcefully held by Islamic police force in Nigeria
item.description: A Muslim police force in Nigeria is holding a 15-year-old Christian girl who has been missing since Dec. 1. Her family fears she'll be forcefully converted to Islam. #Nigeria #childabduction #KanoStateHisbahBoard

item.title: Man pleads not guilty to killing pastor, 5 others including 7-year-old child in murder spree
item.description: A 24-year-old man accused of killing a pastor, a child and four others pleaded not guilty this week to 11 charges linked to a string of shootings in Clay County, Mississippi. Prosecutors said they will pursue the death penalty if he is found mentally competent. #Murder #Homicide #DeathPenalty #ClayCounty #Mississippi

item.title: More Protestant churches closing than opening in America as older congregations struggle: study
item.description: More Protestant churches are being closed in America than are being planted, and older congregations appear to be bearing the brunt of the contraction, according to data from a new Lifeway Research study. #Churches #Protestant #Churchattendence #secularization

item.title: Trump's week in review: Announces 'great healthcare plan,' freezes funding to sanctuary cities
item.description: This week, which marked the final full week of the first year of President Donald Trump’s second term in office, saw the president vowing to take action on sanctuary cities and healthcare reform as he faced criticism for making an obscene hand gesture in response to a heckler at the Ford factory in Detroit, Michigan. The Trump administration also took action to address concerns about visa backlogs for religious workers. #Trump #sanctuarycities #IllegalImmigration #ICE #Healthcare

item.title: Top countries where Christians are suffering, experiencing supernatural: 'Count the cost'
item.description: The 2026 World Watch List, recently released by Open Doors US, a U.S.-based persecution watchdog group, found that approximately 388 million Christians around the world face some form of intense persecution or discrimination for following Jesus Christ. #NorthKorea #China #Somalia #Afghanistan #Nigeria #persecution #OpenDoors

item.title: This week in Christian history: Spain dissolves Jesuit order; Richard Harvey Cain dies
item.description: Events from this week in Christian history include the death of Richard Harvey Cain, Spain dissolving the Jesuit order, and John Bunyan being appointed as a pastor. #JohnBunyan #blackhistory #Spain #civilwar #Jesuits #history #church

item.title: Court case may decide fate of religious symbols in public buildings
item.description: The European Court of Human Rights is reviewing a case that could determine whether religious symbols may be displayed in courtrooms and other public buildings. The case arises from complaints by Greek atheists who say the presence of Christian icons violated their right to a fair trial and religious freedom. #Atheist #Secular #Greece #ChristianIcons #EuropeanCourtofHumanRights #ReligiousFreedom #ADFInternational #UnionofAtheists
